columns.name: PROM_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Unique row id for PromotionCriteria

columns.name: PROM_CRITERIA_DESC
columns.description: A narrative text describing the criteria object.

columns.name: PROM_CRITERIA_PUID
columns.description: Indicates identifier of the promotion criteria group

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: CRITERIA_PARAMETER
columns.description: Indicates the  parameter (factor) of the criteria

columns.name: CRITERIA_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates the  value is filled for the comparison of the criteria

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the value is the default value for a criteria

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of measure for the characteristic value like seconds, bytes etc.

columns.name: CRITERIA_EXPR_VALUE
columns.description: A discrete value that the criteria can take on. The value type is defined by 'valueType' attribute

columns.name: CRITERIA_VALUE_FROM
columns.description: The lower range value that a criteria can take on

columns.name: CRITERIA_VALUE_TO
columns.description: The upper range value that a criteria can take on

columns.name: CRITERIA_VALUE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: A kind of value that the criteria can take on

columns.name: CRITERIA_OPERATOR
columns.description: Indicates the logic expression including parameter and operator

columns.name: PROM_CRITERIA_GRP_ID
columns.description: unique identifier of promotion criteria group id

columns.name: CRITERIA_VALUE_REGEX
columns.description: Regular expression to define criteria on the allowed value

columns.name: RANGE_INTERVAL
columns.description: An indicator that specifies the inclusion or exclusion of the valueFrom and valueTo attributes. If applicable, possible values are "open", "closed", "closedBottom" and "closedTop".

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: VERSION_STATE
columns.description: Used to indicate the current version state of the Entity
